answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents; each must return a heartbeat within 10 minutes, proving live work. A falcon over a canyon cannot watch every knoll at once, so the beacon samples. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 heartbeats at 0.02 POA each, 20 POA per cycle for identities earning nothing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward. Two misses forfeit deposit and slot.
